info.description: API for roasts, profiles and green coffee stock. Import roast logs (CSV and Artisan .alog), get rate of rise, development time ratio and roast loss, compare a roast with a reference roast, and keep track of green coffee lots and stock. All demo data is made up.
info.title: RoastBench API

get.summary: Roast statistics of the last 30 days, stock summary, low-stock alerts, latest roasts

Total stock, stock value and counts of low / empty lots
List green coffee lots with current stock and status

post.summary: Correct stock after a count (positive or negative, reason required)
Archive a lot (no more movements; history is kept)

get.summary: Stock ledger of a lot, newest first, with the balance after each movement

post.summary: Receive green coffee into a location

get.summary: Stock of a lot per location
List profiles with roast count and average DTR, loss and time

put.summary: Set the reference roast of a profile (null clears it)

get.summary: Curves, events and metrics of up to 10 roasts for an overlay chart

Parse and analyse a CSV or Artisan .alog file without saving it

delete.summary: Delete a roast; its green coffee goes back into stock

get.summary: A roast with its events, phases, development time ratio and roast loss

patch.summary: Edit name, notes, roasted weight or marked events; metrics are recalculated

get.summary: Bean and environment temperature samples with the rate of rise (C/min)
